主要内容: On September 4, 2012, Richard G. Rawson, President of Insperity, Inc., established a new structured, prearranged trading plan to sell a portion of his common shares over a six-month period in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The plan allows Mr. Rawson to sell a maximum of 39,064 shares, representing approximately 5% of his current common stock and stock option holdings. The plan was initiated during the company’s open window for insider transactions. Mr. Rawson’s previous trading plans have recently or will soon expire.
